mapper.update: UPDATE financial_summary financial INNER JOIN couple ON couple.inviter_id = financial.member_id OR couple.invitee_id = financial.member_id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.couple_id = couple.id SET financial.updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE financial.member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE member INNER JOIN couple ON couple.inviter_id = member.id OR couple.invitee_id = member.id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.couple_id = couple.id SET member.last_login_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND), member.updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE member.id = #{memberId}

UPDATE member INNER JOIN couple ON couple.inviter_id = member.id OR couple.invitee_id = member.id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.couple_id = couple.id SET member.investment_type = 'VERY_AGGRESSIVE', member.recommendation_input_updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE member.id = #{memberId}

UPDATE common_survey INNER JOIN invitation_code ON invitation_code.common_survey_id = common_survey.id INNER JOIN couple ON couple.invitation_code_id = invitation_code.id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.couple_id = couple.id SET common_survey.updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE couple.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR couple.invitee_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE pension_isa_account pension INNER JOIN couple ON couple.inviter_id = pension.member_id OR couple.invitee_id = pension.member_id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.couple_id = couple.id SET pension.updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE pension.member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE product INNER JOIN recommendation_product ON recommendation_product.product_id = product.id INNER JOIN recommendation_slot ON recommendation_slot.id = recommendation_product.recommendation_slot_id INNER JOIN recommendation ON recommendation.id = recommendation_slot.recommendation_id INNER JOIN couple ON couple.id = recommendation.couple_id SET product.updated_at = DATE_ADD(recommendation.updated_at, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE recommendation_slot.slot_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND recommendation_product.rank_no = 1 AND (couple.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR couple.invitee_id = #{memberId})
